highestRiskCases: A receipt is treated as human authentication or a not-yet-installed validator is claimed to validate its own bootstrap; sequential installed-skill copies expose a partial package or rollback overwrites unknown concurrent state.
Protected base, origin, worktree/common-dir, writer map, or live merged PR state disagrees with a stale active ledger; MCP lacks server/target identity or becomes sticky across A-to-B-to-A calls.
A provider-capable CD job starts before hosted classification; a CD workflow/classifier change self-whitelists from its own merge tree instead of using parent B.
A required unit/static/E2E/security context or reviewer generator is missing while a sibling is green; finalizer succeeds before later feedback or cycles with delivery-gate.
A squash merge lacks parents(T)=[B,H], parent(M)=B, and tree(M)=tree(T); a lane reports H success although tree(H) differs from tree(T).

An untyped line cap pressures production, test, JSON, Markdown, or YAML semantics; an unknown file class passes; a 151-300 production module bypasses function-complexity, duplication, security, test, or coverage evidence; or a >300 module lacks split/rationale disposition.
Runtime authority remains active after merge, terminal failure, process crash, closeout lag, or cleanup failure; MCP/protection rollback erases a legitimate concurrent change.

rollback.mechanism: Preserve and hash exact preimages. Unmerged repository changes are reverted only within the writer map. Skill rollback atomically swaps only exact postimage/preimage peers. MCP/config and protection rollback write only when live equals this operation's exact postimage. Protected main is never rewritten after merge.
rollback.trigger: Any artifact, authority, identity, writer, proof, main-health, CD, reviewer, runtime, provider, resolver, rollback, or cleanup mismatch.
rollback.unknownConcurrentState: Consume the lease/token, preserve observed state and evidence, perform no further mutation, block successors, and use preauthorized failure closeout.

authorityStateMachine.stateOrder: candidate -> approved_event_observed -> bootstrap_pr -> active_child -> prepared -> installing -> installed_consumed|merged_consumed|failed_consumed|rolled_back_consumed|incident -> health_cleanup evidence -> next active_child|closeout_required -> closed|failed
authorityStateMachine.activationRule: The exact human event directly authorizes only B0. Healthy B0 plus external completion receipt/ledger activates B1; later children derive sequentially from exact predecessor consumption, health, cleanup and frozen topology.
authorityStateMachine.repositoryConsumptionRule: Live merged/closed PR or terminal failure immediately makes runtime_authorized false and activeSlice null, even if ledger persistence crashed.
authorityStateMachine.localConsumptionRule: S1 consumes on verified atomic postimage success or terminal installation failure, never by pretending it merged a PR.
authorityStateMachine.postmergeTokenRule: A token is single-use, non-semantic, and limited to exact main health plus declared MCP/config/protection transition and cleanup. Its identity/result are hash-bound in boundary/evidence and never represented as runtime-authorized semantic status.
authorityStateMachine.successorRule: Only the next declared child may activate after exact health, transition and cleanup. Unknown state blocks.
